purpose: Metadata-only evidence for the HOT CRUSH Core V1 design review

objects.object_comment: AI 调用流水，一行一次 LLM 调用：调用方 caller（chatCompletion / chatCompletionMessages / jsonCompletion）、模型名、完整 prompt 与 response 全文、token 数、耗时毫秒；bakery-ops 的 openrouter provider 在成功返回后异步写入，用于离线回放排查「AI 建议不对」。非业务表，prompt/response 是大文本且会持续增长，不要在 Table Editor 里直接全表拉取
空表（0 行）：设计用于存放店长在前端点「采纳 AI 修正」后落库的整日排产系数修正，一天一行（date 唯一），带 coefficient、原因和采纳人/采纳时间审计；bakery-ops ai-correction.repository 写，且只有环境变量 AI_CORRECTION_APPLY 打开时排产才会读取。当前功能未启用
财务分析网站的增删改审计流水，一行一次操作（登录/登出/改密、成本卡新建改归档、原料价格回填、AI 洞察调用），带 before_data / after_data 变更前后快照。务必与 audit_log 区分：audit_log 是 bakery-ops 的 skill 执行日志，两表来源、粒度、写者完全不同，毫无关系
财务分析网站的角色字典，一行一个角色，当前仅 viewer/editor/admin 三行，由 sql/030_app_auth_rbac.sql 种子写入，日常不变。配置表，权限判定要连 app_role_permission 一起看
财务分析网站的登录会话表，一行一个会话（uuid + 会话令牌的 sha256 哈希，约 12 小时过期，登出写 revoked_at）。仅供鉴权用的非业务表，可按 expires_at 安全清理，勿当作用户活跃度统计

财务分析网站的登录账号表，一行一个账号（bigint 主键 + username + password_hash + 锁定/强制改密状态），由财务站 api/_lib/auth.js 与 api/users.js 读写。务必与 users 区分：users 是 bakery-ops 的 WhatsApp/IM 身份表（uuid + 手机号 + permissions[]、无密码），两表无外键无映射，不是同一套账号体系
083 删表前的留档（app_user_role 的 2 行）。角色现在在 app_user.role_code 上。确认无误后可删。
财务站账号的门店可见范围授权，一行一条“账号-门店”授权（store 外键指向 finance_store）。当前为空表（0 行）：没有任何账号被限制门店，管理员按不限门店处理，普通账号按无门店授权处理。由 api/_lib/store-scope.js 读取

候选人投递记录，一行一个候选人对一个岗位（job_openings），stage 为招聘阶段枚举 application_stage（new/contacting/first_interview/trial/…/hired/rejected/backup_pool），由 bakery-ops 的 JobStreet 每日 12:00 拉取与 WhatsApp 招聘 FSM 写入。区别于 employees：employees 是一行一人的员工主档，本表只有在录用时才通过 employee_id 关联过去
面试或试工预约，一行一次预约（kind = interview / trial），挂在 applications 下，由 bakery-ops 招聘 FSM 与面试/试工日报写入；confirmed_by_user_id 引用 users(user_id)（WhatsApp 身份表），不是财务站的 app_user

所有权=bakery-ops，唯一写者 src/modules/data/repositories/forecast-calc.repository.ts updateBusinessRule()，编辑入口 settings-page.tsx。承载 bakery-ops 自有的运营口径 KV（beverageItems=现制饮品清单、stockoutExcludeItems=非生产品清单、breakStockThresholds、shipmentFormula 等）。财务站与 res_api 不得写入。
候选人 WhatsApp 跨天对话状态机，一行一个（门店, 手机号），state 是 FSM 节点、context 是 JSONB 暂存、opted_out 标记候选人回复 STOP，由 bakery-ops 招聘 FSM 写入。它是持久化的候选人会话，区别于 session_state（内部用户 10 分钟 TTL 的临时会话）
多轮对话的最近上下文窗口，一行一条消息（会话 id + user/assistant 角色 + 正文）。注意它不是完整聊天存档：每次落盘按会话整段删除后重插裁剪过的最近若干轮，所以主键不连续、行数远少于真实对话量。由 bakery-ops orchestrator 的 ConversationManager 写入
按日期的上下文事件，一行一条（同一天可多条）：天气、促销等，运行时拼进 AI prompt 以影响次日排产系数；created_by 区分 review（复盘流程自动写入）和 user（人工填写）；bakery-ops holiday.repository 写。目前仅有 2026-04 试运行期的数据，之后未再写入

成本卡物料主数据，一行一个物料，item_type 区分 product 94 / semi_finished 162 / ingredient 184 / packaging 11（共451，全部 active）。由财务分析网站（Vercel，api/cost-items.js）读写。注意：与运营库 product 表是两套互不相干的商品主数据，无外键无映射，按名称仅约 22/54 能对上，勿当同一套用
Internal mutex rows used to serialize normalized cost-card item names; not business master data.
成本卡物料采购价历史，一行一条带生效区间的价格；同时存原始报价（unit_price + currency + price_unit）与归一化后的 normalized_price_myr / normalized_unit，成本计算只认归一化值。财务分析网站写，当前 339 条全部为 MYR、全部 verified，来源均为 MySQL 迁移与回填

POS 商品身份 ↔ 成本卡配方，全局唯一，不分 org 不分门店。pos_item_id = pos_product.item_id，也就是 item_hourly_sales.item_key 的第三段（split_part(item_key,'-',3)）—— item_key 前两段是 org 前缀，不参与映射。一个 POS 商品只能对一张成本卡；一张成本卡可以对多个 POS 商品（同配方不同包装）。映射为人工建立，note 列记录判断依据，不可由程序自动重建。
迁移 080 的留档：重挂前的 94 行旧映射（external_source=mysql:v_product_direct）。确认新映射无误后可 DROP。
成本卡配方头表，一行一个物料的一个配方版本（item_id+version 唯一，status 为 draft/published/archived，带 batch_yield 批产量与 sale_price 售价、生效区间）。财务分析网站写，当前 256 条 published、2 条 archived；配方用料明细在子表 cost_card_recipe_item
成本卡配方明细行，一行一条用料（recipe_id 指向配方版本，component_item_id 指向 cost_card_item，含用量/单位/出成率 net_yield/损耗率 loss_rate/排序 seq）。财务分析网站写，是 cost_card_recipe 的子表，删配方时级联删除
天 × 维度的营收拆分。dim_type=payment 时 dim_value 是支付方式，=dining 时是就餐方式。

定时推送幂等日志，一行 = 某类推送对某个接收人在某天已成功发出一次，(kind, recipient, date) 唯一，服务重启或重跑靠它避免重复推送；bakery-ops 各推送服务写，kind 取值有 morning_brief、production_plan、restock_advice、stockout_detect、order_reminder、weekly_report、jobstreet_pull。非业务表，recipient 是渠道用户 ID

按天一行的门店营收事实表（date 唯一、text 类型，含流水 gross_sales、折扣、实收 revenue、单量、客单价），2025-12-03 起每晚 KL 23:00 由 res_api/sync-to-db.js 从 Restosuite POS 写入，财务站日报导入的旧客户端路径也能写同一行。区别于 finance_revenue_daily（财务模板口径、date+store 唯一的隔离表）和 daily_pnl（Excel 损益表口径）；store / import_source 两列目前全为 NULL（单门店）

AI 生成的每日复盘报告，一天一行（date 唯一）：review_json 是复盘结论、suggestions_json 是次日排产调整建议、adopted 标记是否被采纳；bakery-ops daily-review.service 写。务必与 manager_review 区分——本表是机器生成的结构化复盘，manager_review 是店长手写的复盘原文；本表数据停在 2026-04，当前实际在跑的是 daily-review-chat 那条链路
员工事件流水（转正、奖惩、离职等），一行一个事件，外键挂 employees.id，由 bakery-ops 员工管理/试用期提醒链路写入。当前 0 行，代码已接线但尚未产生数据。与 audit_log（skill 执行日志）、app_audit_log（财务站增删改审计）无关

员工与候选人主档，一行一人（status: active 在职 / resigned 离职），由 bakery-ops 的员工管理、简历上传与招聘 FSM 写入；现有 129 行几乎全部是 2026-06-18 从 HOTCRUSH_EMPLOYEE.xlsx 一次性导入的历史花名册。区别于 applications：applications 是候选人投递记录，只有走到录用才把 applications.employee_id 回填指向本表（目前 0 条关联）

所有权=hbti-web。HBTI 13 题的题目级原始作答，抢锁成功那一刻写一次。写入点 src/lib/store/pg-completion-store.ts recordAnswers()，与 pos_member.hbti_completed_at 同时刻。★永久事实，不带 TTL —— 绝不可加进 purgeExpired 的 EXPIRING 列表（它也没有 expires_at 列，加了会 42703）。
排班事实。一行 = 一天 × 一个人。由门店每天填的 Excel 导入（docs/templates/排班表.xlsx）。★最小事实：只存 duration_h，总工时与人效一律由 v_labor_productivity 现算，不落表。post='OFF' 表示当天休息，保留在表里是为了让这张表同时是当日全员花名册。
门店现金流月表，一行 = 月×门店×项目(期初/现金收入/现金支出/现金退款/现金存入/现金余额)，覆盖 2025-12 至 2026-06；模板六收付款现金流口径，由财务站网页上传与 scripts/import-cashflow.js 写入
门店月度费用归口汇总，一行 = 月×门店×费用大类(major：仓储费/运输费/物料费/其他费用)×子类(sub)×资金来源(source)；由财务站网页上传(api/upload.js，模板三仓运物流+模板四费用表)写入，供损益表与期间费用分层计算。注意与 finance_expense_raw 区分：本表是归口后进损益的费用口径，raw 表是同一批费用按支付渠道的原始拆分明细
门店费用原始拆分明细，一行 = 月×门店×分类×二次分类×支付渠道(银行流水/备用金/报销/现金/收银折扣/仓库订货)的一笔金额，覆盖 2025-12 至 2026-05。仅由一次性脚本 sql/load2.js 从模板四导入，网页上传不写此表；与 finance_expense 的区别是本表按付款渠道记原始明细、不直接进损益归口
单品销售的月度汇总，一行 = 月×门店×单品(数量+金额)，目前只有 2025-12 一个月。粒度与来源都要和兄弟表分清：daily_sales_record 是按天、item_hourly_sales 是按小时且都由 res_api 爬虫从 POS 写入，本表是按月且来自财务模板上传
旧版四维人工成本月表，一行 = 月×门店，只有国内/马来/外包/福利四列合计。已被 finance_labor_detail(模板五新口径)取代，网页上传已明确停止接收该模板(legacy_template_unsupported)，仅作前端缺数时的历史兜底读取，勿再写入
现行人工成本明细，一行 = 月×门店×类别(工资/宿舍/福利/挂账/调整/马来明细/国内工资分摊)×子项×组织；模板五新口径，由财务站网页上传写入，是人工成本的唯一权威表，取代旧的四维表 finance_labor
月度原料成本汇总，一行 = 月×门店×类别(食材/包材)×来源；由财务站网页上传利润表模板写入，目前 source 全部为未拆分。粒度是按月的成本合计，不含单品或供应商明细（后者见 finance_supplier_orders）
月度订货基数，一行 = 月×门店一个金额(MYR，当月仓库订货总额)，用作仓储费按3%、运输费按8%摊销的计算分母；由财务站网页上传写入，个别月份由对账迁移脚本(033/041)按财务确认值校正
物流订货台账，一行 = 一张订货单中的一个商品行，带订货/付款/发货/到港/交付/入库六个日期，按 d_order 日期归月，现有 2026-06 与 2026-07 数据；由财务站网页上传库存模板写入。与 finance_supplier_orders 的区别：本表是单据级明细含全套物流时间戳，那张是按月×供应商×物料的金额聚合
期间费用归类配置，一行 = 费用大类(major)×子类(sub) → 销售/管理/财务/研发费用；全局共用不分门店。损益表据此做期间费用分层，未命中的科目落入待归类并阻断正式损益表导出。人工侧只有 category=工资 的行会进期间费用（与利润表「人力成本」同口径），宿舍/福利/挂账的映射仅供费用穿透页使用
财务利润表关键指标月表，一行 = 月×门店×指标名(当期/摊销运输费、当期/摊销仓储费、达人优惠券、实际收入、储值净额、市场费用(固定)、营业利润、利润总额、净利润(含储值))，覆盖 2025-12 至 2026-05，由一次性脚本 sql/load2.js 从利润表模板导入。务必与 daily_pnl 区分：daily_pnl 是按天的 POS 侧损益(当前 0 行)，本表是按月的财务模板口径
财务模板口径的按天营业额，一行 = 日期×门店，记流水/实收/折扣/折扣率，import_source 恒为 finance_template；专门与外部 POS 写的 daily_revenue 隔离(后者唯一键只有 date、无法多门店)。当前 0 行空表，等待销售模板上传
月度库存盘点快照，一行 = 月×门店×物料(名称+规格)，记现存量/在途量/当月用量/单件体积与采购类型(国内/本地)，覆盖 2026-04 至 2026-07；由财务站网页上传库存模板写入。与 finance_stock_flow 的区别：本表是时点盘点存量，flow 表是按仓别的期初入库领用期末流量
月度进销存流水，一行 = 月×门店×仓别(常温/冷冻)×物料，记期初/入库/领用/期末四个量，覆盖 2026-04 至 2026-07；仅由一次性脚本 sql/load2.js 导入，网页上传通道不写此表。与时点盘点表 finance_stock 互补，目前只被 API 与 AI 事实层读取，前端页面未渲染

财务站门店注册表，一行一家门店，含显示名、启用状态与有效月份区间(active_from_month/active_to_month)，配合 app_user_store_scope 做门店级数据权限。注意这不是运营侧 bakery-ops 使用的 stores 表（那张以 store_code 如 pavilion 为键、带地址班表飞书配置），两表之间无外键无映射，门店名写法也不同（本表用中文全名）
供应商采购明细的月度聚合，一行 = 月×门店×供应商×物料×规格，含数量/单价/金额，来自进销存逐日流水按月汇总并配供应价格单，覆盖 2026-04 至 2026-07；仅由一次性脚本 sql/load2.js 导入。区别于单据级、带订货到入库全套日期的 finance_orders
月度经营目标值，一行 = 月×门店×目标项(总流水/实收金额/折扣费用/食材成本/包材成本/原料成本/人工成本/仓储费/运输费/物料费/其他费用)，覆盖 2026-01 至 2026-07；由财务站网页上传目标损益模板写入，用于实际值对目标的达成率与标准率计算
排产建议快照，一行 = 某天某商品当时实际发出的建议出货量，(date, product_name) 唯一、当天重算即覆盖；bakery-ops forecast.service 生成建议后异步写入。存在的意义是事后复盘「当天到底建议了多少」——因为 product_sales_baseline 会滚动更新，事后重算的结果不等于当日实际发出的建议

HBTI 的不透明认证令牌，一行一个令牌（主键是令牌的 sha256，不是令牌本身）。kind=challenge 是 OTP 挑战（10 分钟，带 state 与 attempts），kind=session 是登录会话（2 小时）。两者合并是因为本质相同：带 TTL 的令牌 + AES-256-GCM 加密载荷。**不是会员数据**：发码时还不知道是谁，且一个会员可以同时持有多个令牌——这正是它没有被收进 pos_member 的原因。payload 明文含手机号与 RES token，只以密文落库。写者 = hotcrush-hbti。
HBTI 完成礼的周边库存池；template_name 必须与 RES 券模板名逐字一致
HBTI 的固定窗口限流计数器，一行 = 一个 (scope, 窗口起点, 主体哈希) 桶。主体可能是会话令牌、手机号或 IP，一律只存哈希。窗口过期后行即失效，靠每日 Cron 清理，读路径不依赖删除。写者 = hotcrush-hbti。
马来西亚公共假期与特殊日期字典，一行一个日期（date 为字符串 YYYY-MM-DD，唯一），coefficient 是该日排产系数（目前 18 条全为空，实际系数走 business_rule）；bakery-ops 设置页维护，排产与 AI 复盘读取
按天 × 小时一行的整店逐时汇总（账单数、客数、净销/流水、平均单价、折扣，date+hour 唯一），2026-01-01 起每晚由 res_api/sync-to-db.js 从 POS 写入，逐时真值无口径问题。和 item_hourly_sales 粒度相同但不拆单品——要单品维度看 item_hourly_sales，要整店逐时看本表

按天 × 小时 × 单品一行的 POS 逐时销量事实表（qty、净销、流水），2026-01-01 起，是本库最细的销售事实来源，daily_sales_record 与 timeslot_sales_record 都由它派生。每晚 KL 23:00 由 res_api/sync-to-db.js 按日期整段删重写，当天数据另由 res_api/scrape-intraday.mjs 日内多次覆盖刷新；同族兄弟：daily_sales_record 按天、hourly_sales_summary 按小时不拆品、finance_item_sales 按月且来自财务模板；store 列全为 NULL

按天 × 单品一行的「当天最后成交时刻」（last_sale_time 为分钟精度的 KL 本地时间）与当日总量，专供 bakery-ops 精确断货检测，2026-07-02 起每晚由 res_api/sync-to-db.js 写入（数据源 res_api/scrape-item-last-sale.mjs）。item_name 与 item_hourly_sales / item_waste 同口径；本表某天缺失时下游会回落到 item_hourly_sales 的小时级口径

按天 × 单品 × 报废原因一行的报废明细（qty 数量、amount 金额），2026-01-02 起每晚由 res_api/sync-to-db.js 从 POS 写入，财务站报废分析与 bakery-ops 复盘/预测都读它。口径坑：waste_reason 在 2026-01～03 有 89 行旧中文值（排产报损/试吃报损/异常报损），之后统一为 scheduling / tasting / production / other / gift，跨期汇总两套值都要算
在招岗位，一行一个招聘位，来源是 JobStreet 职位（external_job_id）或门店二维码海报（qr_token），applications 通过 job_opening_id 挂在它下面，由 bakery-ops 招聘模块写入；当前仅 1 行（Pavilion 前厅 Service crew）
录用 offer 记录，一行一个 application 的 offer，建议薪资默认取自飞书试工流程跟踪表（salary_source=lark）或人工覆盖，由 bakery-ops 招聘流程写入。当前 0 行，实际流程尚未跑到发 offer 这一步

一行一个 POS 会员（store + member_id）的当前状态快照，不留历史。实测总人数 **4,824** = 3,710（档案与卡列表都有）+ 1,111（只在卡列表）+ 3（只有档案没有卡）；注意 4,821 只是「卡列表上的 distinct customerId」，不是人口总数。写者 = ~/hot/res_api 的 scrape-member-snapshot.mjs → sync-to-db.js；本迁移挂在财务仓库的迁移链上只是因为全库唯一带 checksum 校验的迁移执行器在那里 —— **财务站不是写者，只读**。数据源必须是 /crm/datamanage/customer/page ∪ /crm/datamanage/card/page 两个接口的**并集**：只跑 customer/page 会丢掉 1,111 人（23%），他们的 cardShopId=0 被门店权限过滤掉了。金额一律 MYR 元；/crm 接口返回的是**整数分**，抓取侧已除以 100。balance_* 为该会员名下所有卡的合计（4,821 名持卡人中仅 27 人持 2 张卡，故不单独建卡表）。has_profile=false 的约 1,111 行是只出现在卡列表、档案列表查不到的持卡人，他们的 registered_on / source_type 必为 NULL —— 这是事实缺失，不是抓取失败。★ 本表含**一项个人资料：手机号**（phone_country_code / phone_national / phone_e164）。这是数据控制者的明确决定。三列受两道锁保护：前置安全迁移已收回 anon/authenticated 的授予；本迁移第 5 节另行收回三张会员表的 service_role 授予（越权访问报 42501），本表另开 RLS 且不建任何 policy（anon/authenticated 将来被误 GRANT 时只返回 0 行）。service_role 是 BYPASSRLS 角色，RLS 挡不住；它必须始终依靠第 5 节的 REVOKE 保持无权。凡是不需要联系会员本人的分析，一律不要 SELECT 这三列 —— 用 member_id 做聚合与关联。★ 刻意**不落**：姓名 / 邮箱 / 生日 / 性别 / 证件 / 地址 / 车牌 / 第三方身份绑定。不是漏了，是逐字段判过的 —— 判据（实测覆盖率）与将来的追加方法见 sql/060_pos_member_baseline.sql 的**附录 C**，不要凭猜测重新决策。★ 手机号变更历史**不在本表也不在本库**：本表是快照式全量替换，换号后旧号直接消失，POS 的 /crm/memberCard/web/customer/qryChangePhoneLog 是唯一能追回历史的地方（建店至今全量仅 4 行）。是否落这张日志表见**附录 D**。某会员今晚未出现在 POS 快照里时保留旧值，用 snapshot_date 识别失效行，绝不 DELETE。

一行一笔会员卡交易事件，全量约 14,386 行（2025-11 至今），近月约 1,000~1,200 行/月。写者 = ~/hot/res_api 的 scrape-member-flows.mjs → sync-to-db.js（数据源 reportId=100150 行级）；本迁移挂在财务链上只因执行器在那里 —— **财务站不是写者，只读**。这是全库唯一记录「充值」的地方：daily_payment_breakdown 的 'Membership card balance' 只有核销（存量释放），充值这条腿在库里此前完全不存在。txn_type 六种（2024-01-01~2026-07-26 全量穷举，只有这六种）：10 充值 / 20 消费核销 / 30 充值退款 / 40 消费退款 / 50 调增 / 60 调减。实测恒等式：SUM(total_amount) 按 (10+30+50+60) - (20+40) 组合 = 期末储值总余额。金额单位 MYR 元（报表引擎本身返回元，不同于 /crm 的分）。★ 本表**不含任何 PII，包括手机号**。报表返回的 D_customerPhone 刻意不落：实测它是查询时联当前档案取的值，不是交易时点的历史值（6,292 行里 distinct 手机号数 == distinct customerId 数，换过号的 4 个会员只出现一个号），落进来只会得到 14,386 份同批 PII 副本、同时过期、且提供不了任何流水里没有的信息。要拿手机号请用 member_id 关联 pos_member。同样不落 D_customerName / D_customerEmail（PII）、D_orderRemark（自由文本，门店可能手打进客人手机号，是一条绕过本设计的 PII 旁路）、D_operator（实测全月仅 1 个取值，零审计价值且是员工标识）。member_id 以 pos_member 为准：遇到 pos_member 里没有的 member_id，同步侧记 warning，**不要顺手插一条半截的会员记录**。

一行一天 × 一门店的会员日汇总。写者 = ~/hot/res_api；本迁移挂在财务链上只因执行器在那里 —— **财务站不是写者，只读**。本表不含任何 PII。必须分清三个易混淆的兄弟：(a) 本表 card_payment_net 与 daily_payment_breakdown 中 payment_method='Membership card balance' 的 net_sales **口径完全相同**（核销含赠送卡值、已扣消费退款、不含充值），实测 2026-07-20~23 逐日相等，两者互为一致性哨兵；(b) 本表 net_stored_value_cash / net_stored_value_face 与 finance_pl_metrics 中 metric='储值净额' **不是一回事** —— 后者是月粒度、来自财务模板人工维护、与 POS 无数据链路。实测两者按月差 RM 50.53(2026-02) ~ RM 10,169.54(2026-04) 且无规律，**禁止把任何一方当作另一方的校验基准或用于自动勾稽**；(c) member_consume_ratio（会员贡献营业额占比，不限支付方式，来自 POS 的 queryCustomerConsumeRatio）与 card_payment_ratio（卡余额付款占比）是两个不同指标；daily_revenue.member_sales_ratio 对应的是后者。balance_end_* 是存量快照，只能当天抓当天记，事后无法从流水反推 —— 这是本表非做不可的理由。抓不到写 NULL 并置 is_partial=true、把失败来源写进 missing_sources；查询成功但当天确无该类交易时写真 0。**绝不用 0 填补缺失事实**。

一行 = 一个会员订单里的一样商品（同单同品的多行已 SUM 合并）。全库唯一能把会员与具体商品关联起来的表。数据源 = RES 商品报表 reportId=211，过滤 D_isMemberConsume=true；写者 = ~/hot/res_api/scrape-member-order-item.mjs。★ 重复行必须 SUM 不得 DISTINCT：报表对同一(订单,商品)会返回多条完全相同的行，那是同单分行点的同一样东西，去重会导致金额与件数少算约 25%（2026-08-08 实测：原样 RM78,761.75/5,209 件 对得上 hourly_sales_summary 的 RM78,456.19 与 daily_sales_record 的 5,234 件；去重只剩 RM59,277.68/3,930 件）。★ 独立表，未挂财务仓库的迁移链，待数据库重构时统一编排。

商品主数据，一行一个 RES 商品（主键 item_key = RES 的 menuItemNameKey，形如 {orgId}-{orgType}-{menuItemId}）。这是全库唯一的商品身份权威：POS 销售事实、成本卡、供应链都应通过它关联，不要再按名字 JOIN——实测名字路径只能覆盖 2.6% 的营收，且存在 3 组不同商品同显示名。写者 = ~/hot/res_api 的 RES 目录同步；财务站与 bakery-ops 只读。易混淆的兄弟表：product 是 bakery-ops 排产用的中文商品主数据（45 行，只含烘焙品）；cost_card_item 是财务站从 MySQL 迁来的成本卡物料（含原料/半成品）；两者都不是 POS 身份。

当日毛利率。两个口径同时给：margin_pct 是全部有成本卡的品，margin_pct_trusted 只用通过质量检查的品。⚠ 成本卡有错的期间，只看 margin_pct 会被低毛利的错误成本卡拖低 —— 实测 19% 的销售额（含最大单品招牌惠灵顿）落在「毛利率<25%」这一档。cost_coverage_pct / trusted_coverage_pct 是这两个数各自的可信底座，必须一起看。

daily_revenue 与 hourly_sales_summary 的逐日对账。实测 214/214 天营收完全相等、213/214 天单量相等；唯一不符的 2026-04-12 差 25 单，是「无小时归属订单」，不是错误（sync-to-db.js:141-150 的注释写明了这个口径差）。revenue_diff 或 bill_diff 突然变大，说明抓取链路出了问题。

【个人资料 / PII】会员手机号的国家码，POS 字段 areaCode 的规范化结果：纯数字、**不带 '+'**（'60' / '65' / '86' …）。实测 17 种取值，60 占 95.8% —— **不要硬编码马来西亚**。用途：与 phone_national 一起构成可拨打 / 可与 POS 后台核对的完整号码；单独使用无意义。源值为空串 '' 时写 NULL，不要写 ''。★ 安全：本列受 RLS 保护（本表已 ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY 且无任何 policy），且前置安全迁移已收回 anon / authenticated 的全部表级授予；本迁移第 5 节另行收回本表的 service_role 授予 —— **anon 无权访问**（越权读取直接报 42501）。仅 postgres（应用直连身份）可读。

【个人资料 / PII】会员手机号的本地号部分（**不含国家码**），POS 字段 phone 的规范化结果。规范化规则（写入侧 ~/hot/res_api 负责，本列的 CHECK 只是最后一道防线）：(1) 只保留数字，去掉 '+'、空格、连字符、括号（实测源值本就全是纯数字，这一步是防御性的）；(2) **去掉前导 0**（实测 11 条把国内长途冠码一起填进来了，不去掉同一个人会算成两个号）；(3) 空串 '' → NULL；(4) **不要自动剥离前导 60**：实测 6 条数字以 60 开头，与「用户把国家码填进了 phone」    无法区分，也可能是真实本地号 —— 原样入库，事后人工判读（查询见迁移文件附录 B）；(5) 规范化失败（长度异常 / 含非数字 / 不符合 CHECK）时写 **NULL 并报警**，    **不要把原始值塞进来**碰运气。实测长度 7–11（9 位占 83%），覆盖率 4,823/4,824 = 99.98%。NULL 是合法状态：既表示「从未填过」，也表示「POS 侧解绑了」（实测确有一条 有→空 的变更）。★ 安全：本列受 RLS 保护、前置安全迁移已收回 anon / authenticated 的表级授予；本迁移第 5 节另行收回本表的 service_role 授予，**anon 无权访问**。任何不需要联系会员本人的查询都不应该 SELECT 本列。

SELECT item_name AS product_name,
    item_name AS standard_name,
    sum(qty)::integer AS quantity,
    date::text AS date,
    EXTRACT(dow FROM date)::integer AS day_of_week,
    max(item_key) AS item_key
   FROM item_hourly_sales s
  GROUP BY item_name, date;

SELECT c.item_name AS product_name,
    c.unit_cost AS material_cost,
    'cost_card_unit_cost'::text AS cost_source,
    'high'::text AS confidence,
    c.updated_at
   FROM v_cost_card_current_cost c
     JOIN cost_card_item item ON item.id = c.item_id
  WHERE item.item_type = 'product'::text AND c.missing_price_count = 0 AND c.unit_cost IS NOT NULL;

WITH win AS (
         SELECT s.item_name,
            s.date,
            s.hour,
            s.qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN EXTRACT(dow FROM s.date) = ANY (ARRAY[0::numeric, 6::numeric]) THEN 'weekend'::text
                    WHEN EXTRACT(dow FROM s.date) = 5::numeric THEN 'friday'::text
                    ELSE 'mondayToThursday'::text
                END AS day_type
           FROM item_hourly_sales s
          WHERE s.date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 56)
        ), day_count AS (
         SELECT win.day_type,
            count(DISTINCT win.date)::integer AS n
           FROM win
          GROUP BY win.day_type
        )
 SELECT w.item_name AS product_name,
    w.day_type,
    lpad(w.hour::text, 2, '0'::text) || ':00'::text AS time_slot,
    round(sum(w.qty)::numeric / d.n::numeric, 2)::double precision AS avg_quantity,
    d.n AS sample_count
   FROM win w
     JOIN day_count d ON d.day_type = w.day_type
  GROUP BY w.item_name, w.day_type, w.hour, d.n;

WITH current_recipes AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (recipe_1.item_id) recipe_1.id,
            recipe_1.item_id,
            recipe_1.version,
            recipe_1.status,
            recipe_1.batch_yield,
            recipe_1.batch_unit,
            recipe_1.sale_price,
            recipe_1.effective_from,
            recipe_1.effective_to,
            recipe_1.notes,
            recipe_1.row_version,
            recipe_1.created_by,
            recipe_1.published_by,
            recipe_1.created_at,
            recipe_1.updated_at
           FROM cost_card_recipe recipe_1
          WHERE recipe_1.status = 'published'::text AND recipe_1.effective_from <= cost_card_business_date() AND (recipe_1.effective_to IS NULL OR recipe_1.effective_to >= cost_card_business_date())
          ORDER BY recipe_1.item_id, recipe_1.effective_from DESC, recipe_1.version DESC
        ), totals AS (
         SELECT recipe_1.id AS recipe_id,
            COALESCE(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN expanded.is_terminal AND NOT expanded.cycle AND expanded.quantity IS NOT NULL AND price.price_id IS NOT NULL AND price.verification_state = 'verified'::text AND price.normalized_price_myr IS NOT NULL AND cost_card_resolve_unit_factor(expanded.component_item_id, expanded.unit, price.normalized_unit, cost_card_business_date()) IS NOT NULL THEN expanded.quantity * cost_card_resolve_unit_factor(expanded.component_item_id, expanded.unit, price.normalized_unit, cost_card_business_date()) * price.normalized_price_myr
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END), 0::numeric)::numeric(38,12) AS resolved_total_cost,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE expanded.is_terminal AND NOT expanded.cycle)::integer AS terminal_line_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE expanded.cycle OR expanded.is_terminal AND NOT expanded.cycle AND (expanded.quantity IS NULL OR price.price_id IS NULL OR price.verification_state <> 'verified'::text OR price.normalized_price_myr IS NULL OR cost_card_resolve_unit_factor(expanded.component_item_id, expanded.unit, price.normalized_unit, cost_card_business_date()) IS NULL))::integer AS unresolved_line_count
           FROM current_recipes recipe_1
             LEFT JOIN v_cost_card_recipe_expanded expanded ON expanded.recipe_id = recipe_1.id
             LEFT JOIN v_cost_card_price_current_normalized price ON price.item_id = expanded.component_item_id
          GROUP BY recipe_1.id
        ), normalized_totals AS (
         SELECT totals_1.recipe_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN totals_1.terminal_line_count > 0 AND totals_1.unresolved_line_count = 0 THEN totals_1.resolved_total_cost
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END::numeric(38,12) AS total_cost,
                CASE
                    WHEN totals_1.terminal_line_count = 0 THEN GREATEST(totals_1.unresolved_line_count, 1)
                    ELSE totals_1.unresolved_line_count
                END AS missing_price_count
           FROM totals totals_1
        )
 SELECT recipe.id AS recipe_id,
    recipe.item_id,
    item.name AS item_name,
    recipe.version,
    recipe.status,
    recipe.batch_yield,
    recipe.batch_unit,
    recipe.sale_price,
    totals.total_cost,
    (totals.total_cost / recipe.batch_yield)::numeric(38,12) AS unit_cost,
        CASE
            WHEN recipe.sale_price > 0::numeric THEN (totals.total_cost / recipe.batch_yield / recipe.sale_price)::numeric(18,8)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS cost_rate,
        CASE
            WHEN recipe.sale_price > 0::numeric THEN (1::numeric - totals.total_cost / recipe.batch_yield / recipe.sale_price)::numeric(18,8)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS margin_rate,
    totals.missing_price_count,
    recipe.effective_from,
    recipe.effective_to,
    recipe.updated_at
   FROM current_recipes recipe
     JOIN cost_card_item item ON item.id = recipe.item_id
     JOIN normalized_totals totals ON totals.recipe_id = recipe.id;

SELECT 'missing_component'::text AS issue_type,
    'error'::text AS severity,
    recipe.id AS recipe_id,
    recipe.item_id,
    item.name AS item_name,
    '成本卡没有配方组分'::text AS message
   FROM cost_card_recipe recipe
     JOIN cost_card_item item ON item.id = recipe.item_id
  WHERE recipe.status <> 'archived'::text AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM cost_card_recipe_item line
          WHERE line.recipe_id = recipe.id))
UNION ALL
 SELECT DISTINCT 'missing_price'::text AS issue_type,
    'error'::text AS severity,
    root.id AS recipe_id,
    root.item_id,
    item.name AS item_name,
    '存在缺少当前价格的末级原料'::text AS message
   FROM cost_card_recipe root
     JOIN cost_card_item item ON item.id = root.item_id
     JOIN v_cost_card_recipe_expanded expanded ON expanded.recipe_id = root.id
     LEFT JOIN v_cost_card_price_current_normalized price ON price.item_id = expanded.component_item_id
  WHERE expanded.is_terminal AND NOT expanded.cycle AND price.price_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
 SELECT DISTINCT 'price_unverified'::text AS issue_type,
    'error'::text AS severity,
    root.id AS recipe_id,
    root.item_id,
    item.name AS item_name,
    '存在尚未完成单位或币种核验的末级原料价格'::text AS message
   FROM cost_card_recipe root
     JOIN cost_card_item item ON item.id = root.item_id
     JOIN v_cost_card_recipe_expanded expanded ON expanded.recipe_id = root.id
     JOIN v_cost_card_price_current_normalized price ON price.item_id = expanded.component_item_id
  WHERE expanded.is_terminal AND NOT expanded.cycle AND price.verification_state <> 'verified'::text
UNION ALL
 SELECT DISTINCT 'currency_mismatch'::text AS issue_type,
    'error'::text AS severity,
    root.id AS recipe_id,
    root.item_id,
    item.name AS item_name,
    '存在未换算为 MYR 或缺少生效汇率的末级原料价格'::text AS message
   FROM cost_card_recipe root
     JOIN cost_card_item item ON item.id = root.item_id
     JOIN v_cost_card_recipe_expanded expanded ON expanded.recipe_id = root.id
     JOIN v_cost_card_price_current_normalized price ON price.item_id = expanded.component_item_id
  WHERE expanded.is_terminal AND NOT expanded.cycle AND price.currency::text <> 'MYR'::text AND price.exchange_rate_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
 SELECT DISTINCT 'unit_conversion_missing'::text AS issue_type,
    'error'::text AS severity,
    root.id AS recipe_id,
    root.item_id,
    item.name AS item_name,
    '配方用量单位无法换算到价格单位或下级配方产出单位'::text AS message
   FROM cost_card_recipe root
     JOIN cost_card_item item ON item.id = root.item_id
     JOIN v_cost_card_recipe_expanded expanded ON expanded.recipe_id = root.id
     LEFT JOIN v_cost_card_price_current_normalized price ON price.item_id = expanded.component_item_id
  WHERE expanded.is_terminal AND NOT expanded.cycle AND (expanded.quantity IS NULL OR price.price_id IS NOT NULL AND cost_card_resolve_unit_factor(expanded.component_item_id, expanded.unit, price.normalized_unit, cost_card_business_date()) IS NULL)
UNION ALL
 SELECT DISTINCT 'recipe_cycle'::text AS issue_type,
    'error'::text AS severity,
    root.id AS recipe_id,
    root.item_id,
    item.name AS item_name,
    '配方层级存在循环引用'::text AS message
   FROM cost_card_recipe root
     JOIN cost_card_item item ON item.id = root.item_id
     JOIN v_cost_card_recipe_expanded expanded ON expanded.recipe_id = root.id
  WHERE expanded.cycle
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'missing_sale_price'::text AS issue_type,
    'warning'::text AS severity,
    recipe.id AS recipe_id,
    recipe.item_id,
    item.name AS item_name,
    '已发布成本卡没有销售价格'::text AS message
   FROM cost_card_recipe recipe
     JOIN cost_card_item item ON item.id = recipe.item_id
  WHERE recipe.status = 'published'::text AND recipe.sale_price IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (item_id) item_id,
    id AS price_id,
    supplier,
    unit_price,
    currency,
    price_quantity,
    price_unit,
    normalized_price_myr,
    normalized_unit,
    exchange_rate_id,
    verification_state,
    verification_note,
    effective_from,
    effective_to
   FROM cost_card_item_price price
  WHERE effective_from <= cost_card_business_date() AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= cost_card_business_date())
  ORDER BY item_id, effective_from DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC;

WITH RECURSIVE current_recipes AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (recipe.item_id) recipe.id,
            recipe.item_id,
            recipe.batch_yield,
            recipe.batch_unit
           FROM cost_card_recipe recipe
          WHERE recipe.status = 'published'::text AND recipe.effective_from <= cost_card_business_date() AND (recipe.effective_to IS NULL OR recipe.effective_to >= cost_card_business_date())
          ORDER BY recipe.item_id, recipe.effective_from DESC, recipe.version DESC
        ), component_tree AS (
         SELECT root.id AS root_recipe_id,
            line.recipe_id AS source_recipe_id,
            line.component_item_id,
            (line.quantity * (1::numeric + line.loss_rate) / line.net_yield)::numeric(38,12) AS adjusted_quantity,
            line.unit,
            ARRAY[root.item_id, line.component_item_id] AS item_path,
            1 AS depth,
            root.item_id = line.component_item_id AS cycle
           FROM current_recipes root
             JOIN cost_card_recipe_item line ON line.recipe_id = root.id
        UNION ALL
         SELECT tree_1.root_recipe_id,
            child_recipe.id AS source_recipe_id,
            child_line.component_item_id,
            (tree_1.adjusted_quantity * cost_card_resolve_unit_factor(child_recipe.item_id, tree_1.unit, child_recipe.batch_unit, cost_card_business_date()) * child_line.quantity * (1::numeric + child_line.loss_rate) / child_recipe.batch_yield / child_line.net_yield)::numeric(38,12) AS adjusted_quantity,
            child_line.unit,
            tree_1.item_path || child_line.component_item_id,
            tree_1.depth + 1,
            child_line.component_item_id = ANY (tree_1.item_path) AS cycle
           FROM component_tree tree_1
             JOIN current_recipes child_recipe ON child_recipe.item_id = tree_1.component_item_id
             JOIN cost_card_recipe_item child_line ON child_line.recipe_id = child_recipe.id
          WHERE NOT tree_1.cycle AND tree_1.depth < 12
        )
 SELECT root_recipe_id AS recipe_id,
    source_recipe_id,
    component_item_id,
    adjusted_quantity AS quantity,
    unit,
    depth,
    item_path,
    cycle,
    NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM current_recipes child
          WHERE child.item_id = tree.component_item_id)) AS is_terminal
   FROM component_tree tree;

WITH s AS (
         SELECT v.date,
            split_part(v.item_key, '-'::text, 3) AS pos_item_id,
            sum(v.qty) AS qty,
            sum(v.net_sales) AS net_sales
           FROM v_item_sales_keyed v
          WHERE v.item_key IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY v.date, (split_part(v.item_key, '-'::text, 3))
        )
 SELECT s.date,
    sum(s.net_sales) AS net_sales,
    sum(s.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE c.unit_cost IS NOT NULL) AS costed_sales,
    sum(s.qty::numeric * c.unit_cost) AS cogs,
    sum(s.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE c.unit_cost IS NOT NULL) - sum(s.qty::numeric * c.unit_cost) AS gross_profit,
    round(100.0 * (sum(s.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE c.unit_cost IS NOT NULL) - sum(s.qty::numeric * c.unit_cost)) / NULLIF(sum(s.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE c.unit_cost IS NOT NULL), 0::numeric), 1) AS margin_pct,
    round(100.0 * (sum(s.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE q.cost_trusted) - sum(s.qty::numeric * c.unit_cost) FILTER (WHERE q.cost_trusted)) / NULLIF(sum(s.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE q.cost_trusted), 0::numeric), 1) AS margin_pct_trusted,
    round(100.0 * sum(s.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE c.unit_cost IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(sum(s.net_sales), 0::numeric), 1) AS cost_coverage_pct,
    round(100.0 * sum(s.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE q.cost_trusted) / NULLIF(sum(s.net_sales), 0::numeric), 1) AS trusted_coverage_pct
   FROM s
     LEFT JOIN cost_card_product_link l ON l.pos_item_id = s.pos_item_id
     LEFT JOIN v_cost_card_current_cost c ON c.item_id = l.item_id
     LEFT JOIN v_item_cost_quality q ON q.pos_item_id = s.pos_item_id
  GROUP BY s.date;

WITH forecast AS (
         SELECT s.date::date AS d,
            i_1.item_key,
            sum(s.suggested_qty) AS suggested_qty
           FROM forecast_snapshot s
             JOIN v_product_identity i_1 ON i_1.name_zh::text = s.product_name::text AND i_1.is_planned
          GROUP BY (s.date::date), i_1.item_key
        ), actual AS (
         SELECT v_item_sales_keyed.date AS d,
            v_item_sales_keyed.item_key,
            sum(v_item_sales_keyed.qty) AS sold_qty,
            sum(v_item_sales_keyed.net_sales) AS net_sales
           FROM v_item_sales_keyed
          WHERE v_item_sales_keyed.item_key IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY v_item_sales_keyed.date, v_item_sales_keyed.item_key
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(f.d, a.d) AS date,
    COALESCE(f.item_key, a.item_key) AS item_key,
    i.name_zh,
    i.category,
    i.positioning,
    i.is_planned,
    f.suggested_qty,
    a.sold_qty,
    a.net_sales,
    f.suggested_qty - a.sold_qty AS deviation,
        CASE
            WHEN f.suggested_qty IS NULL THEN '无预估'::text
            WHEN a.sold_qty IS NULL THEN '预估了但当日无销量'::text
            WHEN f.suggested_qty > a.sold_qty THEN '高估'::text
            WHEN f.suggested_qty < a.sold_qty THEN '低估'::text
            ELSE '持平'::text
        END AS direction,
        CASE
            WHEN a.sold_qty IS NULL OR a.sold_qty = 0 THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round(100.0 * abs(f.suggested_qty - a.sold_qty)::numeric / a.sold_qty::numeric, 1)
        END AS error_pct
   FROM forecast f
     FULL JOIN actual a ON a.d = f.d AND a.item_key = f.item_key
     LEFT JOIN v_product_identity i ON i.item_key = COALESCE(f.item_key, a.item_key);

WITH measured AS (
         SELECT holiday.type,
            avg(holiday.coefficient) AS type_avg,
            count(*) AS n
           FROM holiday
          WHERE holiday.coefficient IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY holiday.type
        )
 SELECT h.date,
    h.name,
    h.type,
    h.coefficient AS measured_factor,
    COALESCE(h.coefficient, m.type_avg, 1.0::double precision) AS factor,
        CASE
            WHEN h.coefficient IS NOT NULL THEN '实测'::text
            WHEN m.type_avg IS NOT NULL THEN ('同类型均值('::text || m.n) || '个样本)'::text
            ELSE '无依据，按 1.0'::text
        END AS factor_source
   FROM holiday h
     LEFT JOIN measured m ON m.type::text = h.type::text;

SELECT '销售缺 item_key（同步漏键）'::text AS gap_type,
    v_item_sales_keyed.item_name AS name,
    count(*) AS rows,
    round(sum(v_item_sales_keyed.net_sales), 0) AS amount,
    max(v_item_sales_keyed.date) AS last_seen
   FROM v_item_sales_keyed
  WHERE v_item_sales_keyed.key_recovered_by_name AND v_item_sales_keyed.item_key IS NULL
  GROUP BY '销售缺 item_key（同步漏键）'::text, v_item_sales_keyed.item_name
UNION ALL
 SELECT '断货名对不上商品目录'::text AS gap_type,
    o.product_name AS name,
    count(*) AS rows,
    round(sum(o.estimated_loss_amount)::numeric, 0) AS amount,
    max(o.date::date) AS last_seen
   FROM out_of_stock_record o
  WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM v_product_identity i
          WHERE i.name_zh::text = o.product_name::text OR i.name_en = o.product_name::text))
  GROUP BY '断货名对不上商品目录'::text, o.product_name;

WITH recent AS (
         SELECT split_part(v_item_sales_keyed.item_key, '-'::text, 3) AS pos_item_id,
            sum(v_item_sales_keyed.net_sales) AS sales_30d,
            sum(v_item_sales_keyed.qty) AS qty_30d
           FROM v_item_sales_keyed
          WHERE v_item_sales_keyed.date > (CURRENT_DATE - 30) AND v_item_sales_keyed.item_key IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY (split_part(v_item_sales_keyed.item_key, '-'::text, 3))
        )
 SELECT r.pos_item_id,
    i.name_zh,
    r.sales_30d,
    r.qty_30d,
    r.sales_30d / NULLIF(r.qty_30d, 0)::numeric AS realized_price,
    c.unit_cost,
    c.missing_price_count,
        CASE
            WHEN c.unit_cost IS NULL OR r.qty_30d = 0 THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round(1::numeric - c.unit_cost / (r.sales_30d / r.qty_30d::numeric), 4)
        END AS margin_rate,
        CASE
            WHEN c.unit_cost IS NULL THEN 'no_cost_card'::text
            WHEN c.missing_price_count > 0 THEN 'missing_material_price'::text
            WHEN r.qty_30d = 0 THEN 'no_sales'::text
            WHEN c.unit_cost >= (r.sales_30d / r.qty_30d::numeric) THEN 'cost_exceeds_price'::text
            WHEN (1::numeric - c.unit_cost / (r.sales_30d / r.qty_30d::numeric)) < 0.25 THEN 'margin_too_low'::text
            WHEN (1::numeric - c.unit_cost / (r.sales_30d / r.qty_30d::numeric)) > 0.80 THEN 'margin_too_high'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS quality,
    c.unit_cost IS NOT NULL AND c.missing_price_count = 0 AND r.qty_30d > 0 AND c.unit_cost < (r.sales_30d / r.qty_30d::numeric) AND (1::numeric - c.unit_cost / (r.sales_30d / r.qty_30d::numeric)) >= 0.25 AND (1::numeric - c.unit_cost / (r.sales_30d / r.qty_30d::numeric)) <= 0.80 AS cost_trusted
   FROM recent r
     LEFT JOIN cost_card_product_link l ON l.pos_item_id = r.pos_item_id
     LEFT JOIN v_cost_card_current_cost c ON c.item_id = l.item_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT i2.name_zh
           FROM v_product_identity i2
          WHERE split_part(i2.item_key, '-'::text, 3) = r.pos_item_id AND i2.name_zh IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY i2.is_planned DESC, i2.item_key
         LIMIT 1) i ON true;

WITH waste AS (
         SELECT v_item_waste_keyed.date AS d,
            v_item_waste_keyed.item_key,
            sum(v_item_waste_keyed.qty) AS waste_qty,
            sum(v_item_waste_keyed.amount) AS waste_amount,
            sum(v_item_waste_keyed.amount) FILTER (WHERE v_item_waste_keyed.waste_reason = 'scheduling'::text) AS scheduling_waste_amount,
            sum(v_item_waste_keyed.amount) FILTER (WHERE v_item_waste_keyed.waste_reason = 'tasting'::text) AS tasting_amount
           FROM v_item_waste_keyed
          WHERE v_item_waste_keyed.item_key IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY v_item_waste_keyed.date, v_item_waste_keyed.item_key
        ), oos AS (
         SELECT o_1.date::date AS d,
            i.item_key,
            count(*) AS oos_events,
            min(o_1.soldout_time::text) AS first_soldout_time,
            sum(o_1.estimated_loss_qty) AS oos_loss_qty,
            sum(o_1.estimated_loss_amount) AS oos_loss_amount
           FROM out_of_stock_record o_1
             JOIN v_product_identity i ON i.name_zh::text = o_1.product_name::text OR i.name_en = o_1.product_name::text
          GROUP BY (o_1.date::date), i.item_key
        )
 SELECT fa.date,
    fa.item_key,
    fa.name_zh,
    fa.category,
    fa.is_planned,
    fa.suggested_qty,
    fa.sold_qty,
    fa.net_sales,
    fa.deviation,
    fa.direction,
    w.waste_qty,
    w.waste_amount,
    w.scheduling_waste_amount,
    w.tasting_amount,
    o.oos_events,
    o.first_soldout_time,
    o.oos_loss_amount,
    COALESCE(w.scheduling_waste_amount, 0::numeric)::double precision + COALESCE(o.oos_loss_amount, 0::double precision) AS total_loss_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN w.scheduling_waste_amount > 0::numeric AND o.oos_events > 0 THEN '又多做又断货（时段分配问题）'::text
            WHEN w.scheduling_waste_amount > 0::numeric THEN '做多了'::text
            WHEN o.oos_events > 0 THEN '做少了'::text
            ELSE '正常'::text
        END AS loss_pattern
   FROM v_forecast_accuracy fa
     LEFT JOIN waste w ON w.d = fa.date AND w.item_key = fa.item_key
     LEFT JOIN oos o ON o.d = fa.date AND o.item_key = fa.item_key;

SELECT s.date,
    COALESCE(s.item_key, pp.item_key) AS item_key,
    s.item_name,
    s.qty,
    s.net_sales,
    s.item_key IS NULL AS key_recovered_by_name
   FROM item_hourly_sales s
     LEFT JOIN v_pos_item_by_name pp ON s.item_key IS NULL AND pp.name_en = s.item_name;

SELECT w.date,
    COALESCE(w.item_key, pp.item_key) AS item_key,
    w.item_name,
    w.qty,
    w.amount,
    w.waste_reason,
    w.item_key IS NULL AS key_recovered_by_name
   FROM item_waste w
     LEFT JOIN v_pos_item_by_name pp ON w.item_key IS NULL AND pp.name_en = w.item_name;

SELECT s.work_date,
    s.store_id,
    s.area,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.post <> 'OFF'::text) AS on_duty,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.post = 'OFF'::text) AS off_duty,
    sum(s.duration_h) AS total_hours,
    dr.revenue AS turnover,
    round((dr.revenue / NULLIF(sum(s.duration_h), 0::numeric)::double precision)::numeric, 1) AS output_value
   FROM fact_shift s
     JOIN ops_store st ON st.store_code = s.store_id
     LEFT JOIN daily_revenue dr ON dr.date::text = s.work_date::text AND dr.store = st.pos_store_name
  GROUP BY s.work_date, s.store_id, s.area, dr.revenue;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (pp.name_en) pp.name_en,
    pp.item_key
   FROM pos_product pp
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT item_hourly_sales.item_key,
            count(*) AS n
           FROM item_hourly_sales
          WHERE item_hourly_sales.item_key IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY item_hourly_sales.item_key) s ON s.item_key = pp.item_key
  ORDER BY pp.name_en, (COALESCE(s.n, 0::bigint)) DESC, pp.item_key;

SELECT COALESCE(pp.item_key, pr.item_key) AS item_key,
    COALESCE(pr.name, pp.name_zh::character varying, pp.name_en::character varying) AS name_zh,
    COALESCE(pp.name_en, pr.name_en::text) AS name_en,
    COALESCE(pr.category, pp.category_zh::character varying) AS category,
    pr.positioning,
    pr.pack_multiple,
    pr.break_stock_time,
    pr.time_slots,
    pr.id IS NOT NULL AS is_planned,
    pr.id AS product_id,
    pp.sales_price
   FROM pos_product pp
     FULL JOIN product pr ON pr.item_key = pp.item_key
  WHERE COALESCE(pp.item_key, pr.item_key) IS NOT NULL;

SELECT r.date,
    r.manager_revenue,
    d.revenue AS pos_revenue,
    round((r.manager_revenue::double precision - d.revenue)::numeric, 2) AS diff,
        CASE
            WHEN d.revenue IS NULL OR d.revenue = 0::double precision THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round(100.0 * (r.manager_revenue::double precision - d.revenue)::numeric / d.revenue::numeric, 2)
        END AS diff_pct,
    r.manager_transaction_count,
    d.transaction_count AS pos_transaction_count,
    r.manager_revenue_at
   FROM daily_review r
     LEFT JOIN daily_revenue d ON d.date::text = r.date::text
  WHERE r.manager_revenue IS NOT NULL;

SELECT dr.date,
    dr.store,
    dr.import_source,
    dr.revenue AS reported_revenue,
    h.hourly_revenue,
    round((dr.revenue - h.hourly_revenue::double precision)::numeric, 2) AS revenue_diff,
    dr.transaction_count,
    h.hourly_bills,
    dr.transaction_count - h.hourly_bills AS bill_diff
   FROM daily_revenue dr
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT hourly_sales_summary.date::text AS d,
            sum(hourly_sales_summary.net_sales) AS hourly_revenue,
            sum(hourly_sales_summary.bill_count) AS hourly_bills
           FROM hourly_sales_summary
          GROUP BY (hourly_sales_summary.date::text)) h ON h.d = dr.date::text;

SELECT work_date,
    store_id,
    area,
    post,
    split_part(station, '/'::text, 1) AS main_station,
    count(*) AS headcount,
    sum(duration_h) AS hours
   FROM fact_shift
  WHERE post <> 'OFF'::text
  GROUP BY work_date, store_id, area, post, (split_part(station, '/'::text, 1));
